finding: HEAD:src alone does not establish the runtime identity when production src has modified or untracked files.
remediation: Refuse dirty production src before collecting the frozen tree and again before writing replay results. Replay only matching frozen trees and recorded incoming callbacks through the normal production inquiry runtime.
verification: replay.test.ts: 3 tests, 10 assertions; modified/untracked src refusal, incoming callback tamper refusal, retained-state mismatch and exact operational-timing exclusions
limits: Older source trees are recorded as frozen-runtime-not-replayed. Replay equality preserves existing failures and is not task quality acceptance.
